text: 中国央行公开市场开展50亿元7天期逆回购操作，操作利率1.40%，持平上日。 中国央行开展4470亿元隔夜逆回购操作。 今日6730亿元逆回购到期。
text_en: The PBOC conducted a 5 billion yuan 7-day reverse repo operation in open market at an operation rate of 1.40%, unchanged from the previous day. The PBOC also conducted a 447 billion yuan overnight reverse repo operation. 673 billion yuan of reverse repos mature today.
